title: When a user uploads media before entering media details, the upload starts immediately instead of pausing for required metadata input.
body: Expected Behavior: Before the media upload begins, the system should pause and prompt the user to complete media details such as: Title Description Tags Privacy settings Any other required metadata The upload should only proceed after these details are reviewed and submitted. Current Behavior: If the user selects/upload media first, the file uploads directly without showing the media details step. title: [PRO] Issue with Quotas & Credits functionality
body: MemberPress memberships are not rendering for mapping in the membership mappings section. The root cause of the MemberPress issue was a post-type slug mismatch in the plugin's detection logic. Technical Details: Hardcoded Slug: The plugin was specifically searching for the post type 'memberships' to retrieve your membership levels. MemberPress Standard: While intuitive, the official internal slug used by MemberPress for membership levels is actually memberpressproduct.
